meta.note: Names, descriptions, grades and counts as PlayStation publishes them, taken from the Exophase trophy list and cross-checked with PSNProfiles. Guides are this entry's own words; each guide names its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are yours, so there is nothing to do for this one directly. Work the roadmap in order — story first, then side content, then the grinds — and it unlocks itself at the end. If the count reads 54 of 55, the one missing trophy is the one to chase, not this one.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing and see it through to the end. It is the first story mission, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn, and it cannot be missed — just keep playing the story.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1. Chapter trophies unlock automatically when the chapter's last mission ends, so there is no extra step. While you are in Chapter 1, start the meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude — one of them, on Lucia's balcony, is only there during this chapter.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2 and the trophy unlocks when the chapter closes. Nothing here is missable; if you are mopping up side content, do it before moving on only if you like — the chapter itself just needs the story played through.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3. Like the other chapter trophies it unlocks on its own when the chapter's final mission ends, so keep pushing the story forward.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last chapter trophy before the finale, and it unlocks automatically when the chapter ends.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final story mission. It is one of only two gold trophies on the list, and it marks the end of the story — after it, the whole map stays open for cleanup, so nothing here can be missed.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Breakfast Run to its end. Mission trophies unlock as the story passes through them, so this one comes naturally on a story playthrough.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Play the story mission The Cartel Heist to its end. It is a set-piece heist mission, and the trophy unlocks when the mission completes — no side objective needed.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Child's Play to its end. Like the other mission trophies it unlocks automatically when the mission wraps up.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Headliners to its end. The trophy pops when the mission completes; there is no optional objective tied to it.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Play the story mission VCIA Takedown to its end. The trophy unlocks when the mission completes — just follow the mission through.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Play the story mission Operation Savage Glory to its end. It is one of the late-story mission trophies and unlocks automatically on completion.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game completion checklist — the second gold on the list and the hardest trophy by most guides' reckoning. The checklist is the story, the stranger strands, the activities, the collectibles and the challenges, so this trophy is really the sum of all the others: finish the story, clear the side content in stages 2 and 3, then use the checklist itself to find what is left. Community guides put the platinum around 200 hours, most of it here, and note the checklist is more forgiving than a literal 100% of everything. Check your progress in the game's own checklist screen after each stage rather than guessing.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Land 250 stunts of any kind across Leonida. Stunt jumps, flying under bridges, knife-edge flights and base jumps all count, and early guides report there are 397 stunt spots in total, so you have room to pick the easy ones — flying under bridges is widely described as the quickest kind. Keep going past 250 if you want the 100% checklist, which asks for 300. Your count is tracked in the game, so check it between sessions instead of counting by hand.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try all nine activity types at least once: fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, track racing, arcade games, bowling, and the rest the map offers. You only need to take part, not win or finish first, so work through the list in one session — open the map, find each activity marker, and play a round of each. The game counts 9 types, and the trophy pops on the ninth.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every one of the 42 Shooting Range challenges. Visit the range, work through each challenge, and replay any that fall short of gold — the medal for each challenge is shown at the range, so you can see exactly which ones still need gold. Take it slowly and use the range's own scoring to learn each challenge's pace before chasing the gold time or score.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of the 14 drone race locations. Find each location on the map, enter the race, and win it — a win at a location is all that counts, so a location you have already won stays won. Learn each course's line on a practice run, then race it for real.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — 20 distinct race events, not the same race 20 times. Work through the race markers on the map and win each one once; the game tracks which races you have won, so spread your wins across new events. Pick a fast, stable car for each race type and keep the wins coming.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Challenge Cal to a fishing contest and beat him. Fishing is one of the map's activities: find a fishing spot, start the challenge against Cal, and out-fish him — the contest is decided by the catch, so keep your line steady and reel in cleanly. You can retry the challenge if you lose it.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Find an arcade cabinet and finish a full game on it. Any arcade game counts, so pick the one you find first and play it through to its end — completing it, not just starting it, is what unlocks the trophy.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Play through Andy's strand of stranger missions until his final mission, then complete it. Stranger strands unlock as you explore and play the story — follow the strand's markers when they appear, and the final mission's trophy pops on completion.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Play through Kenton's strand of stranger missions until his final mission, then complete it. Like the other stranger finals, it unlocks when the strand's last mission ends — keep following Kenton's markers as they show up.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Play through Billy's strand of stranger missions until his final mission, then complete it. The trophy pops when the strand's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish all 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strands are the side-mission chains given by strangers you meet in the world — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and the rest. Each strand ends in a final mission with its own trophy, and this silver pops when the eighth strand is done. Explore the map and answer the stranger markers as they appear; none of the strands is missable.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Play through Randy's strand of stranger missions until his final mission, then complete it. The trophy pops when the strand's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Play through Tyrone's strand of stranger missions until his final mission, then complete it. The trophy pops when the strand's last mission ends.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida — and mind the one that can be missed. Early trophy guides flag this as the list's only missable trophy: the meditation spot on Lucia's balcony is available in Chapter 1 only, and it disappears once the chapter ends, with no mission replay to go back for it. So meditate there before you finish Chapter 1, then work through the other 17 spots as you explore. Keep a manual save from Chapter 1 until you have this trophy, just in case.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take on Bret's hunting request and bring down the unique animal he asks for. Hunting is one of the stranger strands: follow Bret's missions until the hunt is offered, track the animal, and take the shot. The trophy pops when the hunt is complete.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Finish 3 full sets of collectible cards. Cards are scattered across Leonida, so pick up every card you spot while doing other things and keep a running count per set — the trophy pops when your third set is complete. A card checklist in a community guide is the practical way to find the last few stragglers.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations. WAiNK It is the game's photo-and-share spot activity: open it at marked locations around Leonida and post from each one. Work through locations as you travel for other trophies, and use a map of the 100 spots for the ones you have not visited yet — the count is tracked in the game.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish 50 challenges. Challenges are the small objectives the game hands out across activities and the world — check the challenges screen, pick the ones closest to done, and clear them in batches. Many complete themselves while you chase other trophies, so check the count before grinding the remainder deliberately.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Get the heat up together — commit crimes in the open until the fourth star lands — then break line of sight and stay hidden until the wanted level clears. The trophy pops when you escape with your partner still with you, so do it in open country where you can lose the pursuit cleanly.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob 3 shops in a row without the wanted level dropping between them. Pick three shops close together, hit them one after another, and keep moving — the streak only counts while the wanted level stays live, so plan the route first and do not stop to fight the police. A fast getaway car parked nearby helps.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Getting into a new vehicle model for the first time counts as a discovery, so drive anything you have not driven before — traffic, parked cars, bikes and boats all count toward the variety. The game tracks your discovered count, so check it as you go and hunt the rarer models last.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Trigger Combat Focus once and drop 5 enemies before it ends. Find a spot with a cluster of enemies — a gang hideout or a shootout with plenty of cover — activate Combat Focus, and work through five targets in the same activation. If you run out of targets, let the moment pass and try again in a busier fight.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At Vice City International Airport, get into a plane and take off without a scheduled flight — an unscheduled departure. Find a plane on the tarmac, climb in, and get airborne; the trophy pops when you leave the airport by air on your own terms.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Do something memorable in a Rhino tank — the description's own joke is the hint, so get behind the wheel of a Rhino and make it count. Rhinos turn up at military spots and in the later chaos of the story; once you have one, cause the kind of destruction only a tank can, and the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store clean, without ever being spotted. Go in quiet: move slowly, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the goods, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are detected, leave and try again — detection fails the attempt, not the trophy.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and get away clean each time. Vaults are the bigger robbery jobs: plan the approach, crack the vault, grab the take and escape before the response closes in. Each completed vault-and-escape counts, so work through five of them — the count is tracked, and the silver pops on the fifth escape.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Find an armored truck on the road, stop it, crack it open and escape with the take. Armored trucks patrol the highways — block one, force it open, grab the cash and break away before the police box you in. A fast car waiting nearby makes the escape far easier.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Visit all 52 regions of Leonida. Exploration is tracked per region, so drive, fly and sail into every corner of the map — Vice City, the beaches, the swamps, the Keys and the countryside — until each region registers as visited. The map itself shows which regions you have covered; use it to find the ones left.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation from each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Illegal operations are the gangs' side businesses — find each gang's operation, hit it, and get out. Work through the gangs one by one; the game tracks which gangs you have hit, so check the count and hunt the gangs you have not touched yet.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to Ocean Beach, find a bar with a view of the water, and order a cocktail. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a challenge — sit down, take in the view, and enjoy the drink. It pops when the moment lands, so just let the scene play out.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a car straight through a vehicle showroom's glass front and out the other side, in classic GTA style. Pick a showroom, build up speed on the approach, and smash through the window — the trophy pops when you break out through the glass.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and play a full game, following through on the lane. Bowling is one of the map's activities: pick up a ball, bowl your frames, and finish the game — the trophy pops when the game ends.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Build a partnership that the whole state notices. This one is tied to the story's duo — keep playing the story with your partner and the moment comes on its own. If it has not popped, push the story forward; it is not a grind, it is a story beat.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make 500 choices across the game. Choices are the small decisions the game keeps count of — dialogue options, responses and actions that pick one path over another — so this one builds up simply by playing and answering. Keep choosing, keep playing, and the count climbs on its own; check the tracker to see how far along you are.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Fail at something, then get it right on the second try. The name gives it away: this trophy is about the retry — attempt a challenge, miss it once, then nail it on your next attempt. It pops on that successful second try, so if you fail something, take the retry instead of reloading an old save.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Stumble into one of Leonida's stranger moments — the kind that makes you stop and ask what just happened. These odd encounters are hidden around the map, so explore off the beaten path and investigate anything that looks out of place. The trophy pops when you find one.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a moving vehicle, knock people over with a melee attack — a drive-by with a bat, not a gun. Get a vehicle rolling past a group on foot, swing your melee weapon from the window or the seat, and bowl them over. It takes a steady hand at speed, so pick a slow stretch of road with pedestrians and line the swing up.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take the dirty money to your contacts and wash it into clean cash. The total is cumulative, so every robbery feeds it; keep robbing and laundering and the count climbs. The game tracks the laundered total, so check it between jobs.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across the shops of Leonida. Every purchase counts — clothes, weapons, car parts, food, anything with a price tag — so just buy what you need as you play and the total adds up. If you are close, a big purchase at a car dealership or a weapon shop closes the gap fast.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties. Garages are for sale around the map — check the property markers, visit each one, and buy it. They cost money, so save up or sell off what you do not need, and the trophy pops when the eighth garage is yours.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the app on your in-game phone, add a vehicle you own or have found, and repeat until ten are registered. Any ten vehicles count, so register the ones you drive most and the trophy pops on the tenth.
